StudyDesk is not made by, or connected to, any college, university or exam board. Exam dates are copied from official date sheets; always confirm them on the official website.
High, medium and low chance are estimates based on how often a kind of question appears in past university papers and on the syllabus weight. They are a guide for revision, not a promise.
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your progress, highlights and notes stay on your phone. The app only downloads study content from its content server.
Subject lists follow the official syllabi named on each course. Notes and questions are written for this app.

Built with Android Jetpack (Apache 2.0), Kotlin and kotlinx libraries (Apache 2.0), Ktor (Apache 2.0), OkHttp (Apache 2.0), Coil (Apache 2.0), Dagger Hilt (Apache 2.0) and commonmark-java (BSD 2-Clause).

Designed and built by Shubham Kumar, a Mobile Software Engineer (SDE-3) with over 5 years of experience shipping iOS and Android apps. StudyDesk was crafted end to end — offline notes, spaced revision, MCQs and full mock papers.

StudyDesk began as a way to help a close friend get through her exams — turning a scattered syllabus into notes that are clear, calm and genuinely exam-ready. It is also a quiet proof of what careful engineering can do when it is built for someone who matters.
